name: ThankYouCardPaymentState
description: Whether a payment request is still payable. Expiry is not one of the values — it is derived from valid_until on read.

values.name: OPEN
values.description: Asked for, not yet confirmed. Still payable if valid_until has not passed.

values.name: CONSUMED
values.description: Taken. Set before the booking runs, by an update conditional on the row still being open — that conditional update is the lock.

notes: There is no 'booked' value, on purpose. Consuming and booking are two writes that cannot be made atomic, so the state says only that the request was taken; whether the money moved is a question for transactions.
An expired request is still 'open' in this column. Both implementations must compare valid_until on read — reading the state alone honours a request that ran out an hour ago.
